meta.notes: Lối lên đồi từ Poppy Reach: đường đá lửa ướt dưới mưa, khóm anh túc cuối cùng, bậc thềm vôi trắng (A18.6) lên sân trước cổng có tường hốc nến đứng yên (A18.5). Tháp cổng (A11.4): mưa dừng ở cổng — bên trong khô, ấm, đứng yên. Cloister vuông 12 vòm (A11.1) quanh sân cỏ (garth). Phòng bệnh dài: 14 giường (A11.2), 13 người ngủ mỉm cười trong vải lanh sạch, giường trống của Fen, Tamsin trốn sau bình phong (A19.5), cửa sổ cao mỗi bậu một ngọn nến đứng yên (A19.6), chân nến giống hệt nhau không bao giờ lập lòe (A11.6). Bảy bậc lên phòng Mẹ Hawise: cửa sổ cao ấm nhìn ra thung lũng (ánh sáng sáng nhất, đứng yên nhất của act), ghế cửa sổ (A19.3), trà anh túc (A19.2, vision). Nhà ăn (A11.3, bánh mì, hoa), bếp (lò A11.5 sạch, không lửa), phòng vải lanh, cầu thang đêm xuống Garden of Hush. Không chiến đấu; overlay Tuần tra: lối đi + nón tầm nhìn của các sơ, lối đưa Tamsin ra cổng. Mái nhà chỉ hiện khi tâm camera ở ngoài trời.

provenance.name: The Gentle House
provenance.area: Holy place · no combat · D4 C0 · 12 min

target.note: full map: the climb from the Poppy Reach (~100 m of switchbacks between drystone walls), the forecourt, a compound ≈ 45 × 35 m with the ward's upper storey (the high window), a chapel and the sisters' dormitory; this slice is 66 × 94 m (a 40 m climb)

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).

terrain.note: interior floor: floorY(x, z) of the rooms (levels, sloping floors, stairs, ramps); NaN = no floor (outside the rooms / under the walls)

heightfield.sample: cell centre: x = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell

wallShade.note: grey vertex colour of every wall vertex (multiply the base colour; vertexColors = true): c = lerp(1, topDark, smoothstep(h, top, top + fade)) * (0.82 + 0.18 * smoothstep(h, 0, 0.5)), h = vertex y minus the floor height under it (floorY(x, z), metres); `top` = the wall style top (style.top, default style.height * 0.62). The wall fades to black above its top (no ceiling: the room dissolves into darkness) and is slightly darker at the foot

floorShade.note: grey vertex colour of floor mesh corners (x, z) with dv = wallDistance(x, z) (metres; > 0 inside a room, < 0 outside / under a wall): walkable floor c = 0.86 + 0.14 * smoothstep(dv, -0.2, 1.2) (slightly darker at the walls); apron (floor cells past a void edge, not walkable, up to `apron` m) c = 0.86 * (1 - smoothstep(-dv, 0, apron * 0.8)) (fades to black)

A11.1.name: Whitewashed cloister bay (three round arches)
A11.1.note: the GLB is a closed little pavilion (solid back wall, both end walls, a gable roof over a 1 m walk): its back and end walls below the roof (y < 2.42 m) are cut away so the walk behind the arches stays 1.9 m wide and runs on from bay to bay; arches 1.1 / 1.0 / 0.9 m between the four piers (the blockers); the roof covers the walk (the wall fade opens it round the focus; the exterior-only N-HS12 roofs are dropped)

A11.2.name: Hospice bed
A11.2.note: two rows in the ward; Fen's bed (north row, east end) is empty; the GLB is keyed on the 2.16 m length; uniformly it was 1.71 m wide (concept 1.08 m) and read as a double bed with one sleeper, so the prep narrows its width alone ×0.7 to 1.2 m (prepare-act1-kit.py SQUASH, kit fix 10-23: a plain bed frame, the texture stretch is small); 1.5 m stays between beds at the 2.71 m pitch (the candle stands and windows stand there); mattress top 0.67 m (the sleepers lie at 0.70)

A11.3.name: Refectory table with bread (two benches)
A11.3.note: two tables + the high table; the bread is always fresh; keyed on the 4.32 m length the GLB top stands at 1.2 m: placed at scale 0.68 (2.94 × 1.41 × 1.75 m, top 0.82 m, benches 0.40–0.46 m); it brings its own jug of flowers (no A19.1 vase on it)
